finalText:
Redis crashed at 02:14:07, and everything downstream fell with it. Without the cache, the store got hammered by direct reads, backed up fast, and workers started timing out. The request queue climbed from 52 to over 560 requests piled up waiting. After about 17 minutes of this, the heap ran out of memory trying to hold all those queued requests, and worker-2 died. The API became unresponsive soon after, and the supervisor shut the whole service down.

Redis reconnect tried 12 times and never succeeded — the connection to 10.0.0.12:6379 kept getting refused. Check why Redis went down and whether it's back up now.
